title: Causal Event-Preserving Semantic Refresh Scheduling Q0 R0.1
research_question: Can the existing Q0 fixed-period counterfactual traces be evaluated at risk-episode and signed-feedback-delay granularity without rerunning detector input or training a scheduler?

allowed_inputs: Existing Q0 R0 full-rate reference trace
Existing Q0 R0 scored truth-item table

estimand.primary: Risk-episode alignment and signed feedback timing difference between each fixed-period arm and the full-rate reference
secondary: Constrained best operating point under predeclared Development gates
estimand.frame_unit: One source capture frame for causal state transitions
estimand.episode_unit: One contiguous active risk-signature run within one source session
estimand.cluster_unit: Source session; frames and episodes are repeated observations and are not independent samples
estimand.uncertainty: Descriptive counts and quantiles only; no frame-level p-values or generalization claims

new_episode_when: Active state changes from clear to active
Active state changes from active to clear
Any risk signature field changes while active
episode_definition.interval_convention: Start at the first active frame timestamp; end immediately before the first subsequent frame outside the episode, or one median within-session frame step after the final frame
episode_definition.event_id_rule: active_event_id increments on each clear-to-active transition and remains stable through active signature changes; next_event_sequence_number is independent state

episode_matching.rule: One-to-one same-session positive-overlap greedy matching, ordered by overlap duration then temporal IoU
reported: Feedback count delta per matched episode
episode_matching.feedback_match_rule: One-to-one timestamp matching within the fixed tolerance, ordered by absolute time difference

truth_item_delay.signed_definition: candidate first feedback timestamp minus reference first feedback timestamp within the same positive-event interval
reported: Feedback count delta for every truth item
truth_item_delay.negative_window_delay: Not applicable; negative windows retain hit and feedback-count metrics without onset-delay interpretation

operating_point_selection.decision_rule: Among admissible VALID policies, minimize detector call count; break ties by absolute episode onset-delay P95, then Level-3 divergence
operating_point_selection.learned_policy_comparison: Not applicable until an independent current-frame-only fast-feature stream and session-held-out split exist

claim_ceiling: This repair establishes only a reproducible Development-only episode-alignment diagnostic over already-consumed Q0 traces. It does not establish semantic truth, tracker quality, energy, thermal behavior, Android behavior, product equivalence, safety or learned-policy superiority.
stop_rules: Do not overwrite or reinterpret the Q0 R0 protocol or result
Fail closed on input identity, frame timestamp or reference parity mismatch
Do not treat an admissible operating point as a deployment recommendation
Do not train or evaluate Logistic without an independent current-frame-only fast-feature trace
Do not rerun old R2/R3, detector collection or Android execution
